maddeler.e:
تماهيت (form VI)
# تَمَاهَيْتُ (tamāhaytu) /ta.maː.haj.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَمَاهَى (tamāhā)
# تَمَاهَيْتَ (tamāhayta) /ta.maː.haj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَمَاهَى (tamāhā)
# تَمَاهَيْتِ (tamāhayti) /ta.maː.haj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَمَاهَى (tamāhā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
